idea-plugin.description:
Uniscript: type any Unicode character in plain ASCII and style it. <:alpha> <:fracture A> \:infinity → α 𝔄 ∞

  • Edit | Uniscript | Uniscript → Unicode and Unicode → Uniscript convert the selection, or the whole file.
  • Uniscript tags are highlighted in every file type; unknown entities are errors, characters without a Unicode counterpart warnings.
  • Completion of entity names, block words and block operands inside tags, opening by itself after <: and \:; the character is shown beside each name, names sharing a prefix fold into one group. Enter inserts the character, Tab the name.
  • Alt+Enter on a tag: Replace with α.
  • Each tag folds to its Unicode (<:fracture A> shows 𝔄) and unfolds under the caret.

action.description: Convert the selection or file from uniscript (<:alpha>) to Unicode (α)
Convert the selection or file from Unicode (α) to uniscript (<:alpha>)
